title: deliver loop status
description: Deprecated (removed in the next minor release): read the run events and their projection (deliver-run-state.schema.json) instead. Live state of a deliver loop, the projection of its progress events plus schemaVersion, written by the loop to .agents/deliver-loop/status.json of the repository (raw URL on main: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GravionLabs/skills/main/skills/delivery/deliver/schema/deliver-loop-status.schema.json). Rules: (1) the loop writes the file atomically: a temp file next to it, then rename over status.json; readers never see a partial file. (2) updatedAt is set on every write. (3) Unknown fields are allowed at every level: readers ignore what they do not know, writers may add fields without a schemaVersion bump; a breaking change bumps schemaVersion. (4) A reader treats a file whose updatedAt is older than 1 hour while result is running as stale (the loop died or was killed), not as running. (5) PR and issue numbers are GitHub numbers; URLs are the full GitHub URLs. (6) needsYou lists what a human must decide or do; blocked and paused carry the reason from the progress line.

run.description: Run id, the name of the run folder under .agents/deliver-loop/.

key.description: M<n> or M<n>.<k>; stable across the close rename.

closed.description: Closed `pbi` and `bug` issues of the milestone (the stop-rule set), Features and Epics excluded.

total.description: All `pbi` and `bug` issues of the milestone (the stop-rule set), Features and Epics excluded.

current.description: The PBI the loop works on now, null between items and when the loop has ended.

text.description: Short step text, for example review: clean.

delivered.description: PBIs merged in this run, in order.

needsYou.description: What a human must decide or do.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time, UTC with Z or an offset.
